analysis.suggestedPrompt:
REPLICATE THE REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY. Only two types of changes are permitted: (1) replace 'PestLab' brand name with 'Bugo' and (2) replace all English text with Hebrew text, right-aligned (RTL). Every visual element — colors, layout, hand position, devices, discount badge, banner — must be pixel-identical to the reference.

BACKGROUND: Blurred outdoor lawn/garden background with soft green grass texture and natural lighting. Shallow depth of field creating bokeh effect in background.

HEADLINE (top-center, two lines):
Line 1: "ההבטחה שלנו: לא עוד מזיקים" — white bold sans-serif, large size, slight text shadow for readability
Line 2: "או כסף בחזרה" — white bold sans-serif, same size as line 1

SUB-HEADLINE (below headline):
"אפס סיכון. תוצאות אמיתיות" — white text inside red rounded rectangle banner (#E53935), white bold text, centered

DISCOUNT BADGE (left side):
Red circular starburst badge (#E53935) with jagged edges
Text inside badge (white, bold):
"עד" — small text at top
"40%" — large bold numbers in center
"הנחה" — small text at bottom

PRODUCT (center): 
Replace the 3 PestLab mole repeller stakes with 3 Bugo ultrasonic pest repeller devices. Each device should be the white oval/egg-shaped Bugo unit with blue LED glow (#2196F3) from bottom rim. 'Bugo' text in gray on each device face. Hand position identical - adult hand holding all 3 devices in a fan arrangement. Same lighting, same shadows, same perspective.

BOTTOM BANNER:
Solid red rectangle banner (#E53935) spanning full width at bottom
White bold text, centered: "הצעה מוגבלת בזמן"

ASPECT RATIO: 1:1

DO NOT add any element not present in the reference. DO NOT remove any element. DO NOT reposition any element. The layout, composition, lighting, and visual hierarchy must be identical to the reference image.
